items.title: Jennifer Lopez Makes Rare Comment About 'Tough' Marc Anthony Divorce
items.summary:
Jennifer Lopez makes a rare comment about her 2011 split from ex-husband Marc Anthony in her upcoming concert special.

“After my third divorce — that’s when I really started getting good at it,” the “Let’s Get Loud” singer, 57, tells her Las Vegas audience with a laugh in The JLO Show , which premieres on CBS and Paramount+ Thursday, November 26. “It’s not funny. It’s funny! It is funny. It’s not funny.”

Lopez candidly admits on stage that her separation from Anthony, 58, was “a really tough time,” as the couple had welcomed their twins, Max and Emme, only three years prior.

“It was one of those moments in life where you’re just about to give up on it all,” she reflects. “You’re just like, ‘I’ve given up on love. I’m giving up on life, the whole thing.’ But I had these two little baby twins, you know?”

Jennifer Lopez's Dating History: A Timeline of Her Famous Relationships 

The Grammy nominee tells the crowd that she decided to call one of her “mentors,” motivational speaker and self-help author Louise Hay , for some guidance at the time.

“I said, ‘I don’t know what I’m going to do. I don’t know how to go on,'” she recalls. “And she said, ‘Jennifer, you’re a dancer, right?’ I said, ‘Yes, I am.’ And she said, ‘When you’re learning a dance and you get the steps wrong, what do you do?’ I said, ‘I just keep going until I get the steps right.’ And she said, ‘That’s it, Jennifer. Always keep dancing.'”

Marc Anthony Emma McIntyre/Getty Images

Tovah Feldshuh revealed whether she will appear on Nobody Wants This season 4 after offscreen tension over Adam Brody ‘s public support for Palestine.

items.title: WWE Star Thea Hail Shaves Head on Live TV Amid Alopecia Diagnosis at Age 23
items.summary:
WWE NXT star Thea Hail bravely shaved her head on live TV after being diagnosed with alopecia at age 23.

Back in August, Hail, real name Madison Knisley, shared via Instagram that she had alopecia areata, which, according to the Mayo Clinic , causes hair to fall out in patches. “Alopecia areata is a common autoimmune disorder affecting about 1 in every 1,000 people,” per the Mayo Clinic, with over 80% of people diagnosed with the condition showing signs of alopecia areata before the age of 40.

On the Tuesday, November 24, episode of WWE NXT on The CW, Hail got emotional as she addressed her progressive hair loss in front of the live audience at the WWE Performance Center in Orlando, Florida.

“You’re expected to walk through that curtain and look perfect,” Hail said through tears, acknowledging the beauty standards placed on women in professional wrestling.

10 Celebrities Facing Hair Loss, and What They Use To Fight It 

“I’m sure you can all imagine how afraid I was to share with the world that at 23 years old, I was diagnosed with alopecia,” she continued. “In less than four months, I lost about 40% of my hair. Since July, I’ve been asking myself the same questions you’re all probably wondering: will it grow back? How will I look? What does this mean? But most importantly, how will other people look at me if I have no hair?”

The former NXT Women’s North American Champion vowed to “take this moment of weakness and turn it into a strength” because “alopecia has been a bit of a blessing in disguise for me.”

items.title: Patrick Stewart Was 'Struggling With His Health' on 'Avengers: Doomsday' Set
items.summary:
The late Patrick Stewart managed to shoot one last movie before his death, but it was not without difficulty.

The legendary actor died in October from Alzheimer’s disease and Lewy body dementia. He was 86.

Stewart’s final movie, Marvel Studios’ highly anticipated Avengers: Doomsday , is set for release on December 18, and directors Anthony and Joe Russo , as well as Marvel Studios president Kevin Feige , recalled how he gave a speech on his final day on set.

“I think it was in the back of all of our heads [that] we may never see him on set again,” Anthony told Entertainment Weekly in an interview published on Tuesday, November 24.

Kyle MacLachlan and More Stars Mourn Patrick Stewart’s Death at 86 

“It was clear that he was struggling with his health, and he worked so hard to deliver a performance and a presence — for us as directors, for his other actors, for the crew,” Anthony continued.

Anthony added, “You could see it wasn’t just the effort of a regular actor showing up and delivering that kind of presence and performance and experience for others, collaboration. It was someone who was really being challenged in a very deep way on a health level, showing up and doing that. For him to have muscled through and delivered the performance that he did in that movie and the experience that he delivered for all of us as collaborators, it made it intensely emotional.”

Stewart reprises his role as X-Men leader Professor Charles Xavier in the new Avengers movie.
